record.original_question: Let H_η be the generalized Pickands constant associated with a centered Gaussian process η(t) with stationary increments, continuous sample paths, η(0)=0, and variance function σ_η^2(t), defined by the limit H_η = lim_{T→∞} H_η(T)/T where H_η(T)=E exp(max_{t∈[0,T]}(√2 η(t)−σ_η^2(t))). Find additional characterizations of H_η that can lead to more precise estimates of this constant.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\eta=\{\eta(t):t\ge 0\}$ be a centered Gaussian process with stationary increments, almost surely continuous sample paths, $\eta(0)=0$, and variance function $\sigma_\eta^2(t)=\mathrm{Var}(\eta(t))$. For $T>0$, define
$$H_\eta(T) \;=\; \mathbb{E}\,\exp\!\Big(\max_{t\in[0,T]}\big(\sqrt{2}\,\eta(t)-\sigma_\eta^2(t)\big)\Big),$$
and assume the limit
$$H_\eta \;=\; \lim_{T\to\infty}\frac{H_\eta(T)}{T}$$
exists in $(0,\infty)$; this number is called the generalized Pickands constant associated with $\eta$.

The classical Pickands constant $\mathcal{H}_\alpha$ corresponds to the case $\eta(t)=B_\alpha(t)$, a fractional Brownian motion with Hurst index $\alpha/2\in(0,1]$, in which case $\sigma_\eta^2(t)=t^\alpha$. For general admissible $\eta$, only crude bounds on $H_\eta$ are known, and explicit values are available only in isolated cases (e.g.\ $\mathcal{H}_1=1$, $\mathcal{H}_2=1/\sqrt{\pi}$).

Problem: Find new equivalent characterizations or representations of the generalized Pickands constant $H_\eta$ (for instance, as expectations not involving a limit, variational formulas, or expressions in terms of auxiliary stochastic processes) that yield sharper quantitative estimates—upper bounds, lower bounds, or asymptotic expansions—for $H_\eta$ than those currently available.
artifact.status_search_result: Pickands constants and their generalizations remain a very active area, with progress on alternative representations (e.g., Dieker–Yakir-type expectation formulas, max-stable process representations) and on bounds and simulation methods. However, no closed-form expression or sharp characterization is known for general $\eta$, and obtaining sharper estimates for $H_\eta$ is still regarded as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: Generalized Pickands constants and stationary max-stable processes
status_evidence.snippet: A novel representation of Pickands constants is derived as a simple expectation without a limit operation, extending Dieker–Yakir representations to a broader class of processes.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work provides new representations of generalized Pickands constants, but their exact values remain unknown in general.

status_evidence.title: Simulation of Pickands constants
status_evidence.snippet: Pickands constants are defined as limits whose exact value is often unknown; only crude bounds and Monte Carlo estimates are available.
status_evidence.claim: Sharp estimates of Pickands constants are still lacking, motivating the search for further characterizations.
